newsitem.title: GERMANY: DBV Wintherthur plans to up 96 dividend to 11 dmk.
newsitem.headline: DBV Wintherthur plans to up 96 dividend to 11 dmk.

text.p: German insurer DBV Winterthur said on Tuesday it was planning to raise its 1996 dividend to eleven marks per share, a rise of one mark.

The group said at its annual news conference that it expects higher group earnings in 1997. For the 1996 business year the group reported group net profits of 93.3 million marks, a rise of 23.4 percent.
DBV Winterthur said that its earnings per share, calculated using the DVFA German analysts' method, rose 35.90 percent to 31.40 marks per share in 1996.
The dividend increase would be proposed at the group's annual shareholder meeting on June 25.
